annotations.title: URL Normalizer & Tracking Parameter Stripper API

description: URL Normalizer & Tracking Parameter Stripper API: Canonicalize URLs and strip 120+ ad-tracking and click-ID parameters for clean deduplication. (Endpoint: POST /v1/url-normalizer)

custom_strip_params.description: Additional query parameter names to remove (case-insensitive).

resolve_shorteners.description: If true, resolves redirects via the SSRF-isolated fetcher Worker before normalizing.

sort_query.description: Sort remaining query parameters alphabetically by key.

strip_tracking.description: Strip UTM, click-ID (fbclid, gclid, msclkid, etc.), and email tracking parameters.

strip_trailing_slash.description: Remove trailing slash from non-root paths (/blog/post/ -> /blog/post).

strip_userinfo.description: Strip user:pass@ credentials from the URL authority (default true).

url.description: URL to canonicalize and strip tracking parameters from.

name: tinplate_url_normalizer
